selection_rule: Require residual, ERB, and contralateral-high-frequency validation metrics not to regress versus the zero-CNN v2 initialization; maximize the minimum relative improvement across ERB, contralateral high frequency, and ILD; then compare mean perceptual improvement and total loss.
selection_note: All candidates improved residual, ERB, and contralateral high frequency. ILD proxy regressed for all three, but 0.75 had the best maximin value by limiting ILD regression to 2.08%; strict HRIR-ILD fine-tuning remains a separate later stage.
test_policy: The locked test split must not be exported or read.
